input.quote: a. providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and
input.rationale: We have a convenience right on one month's written notice (effectively the preferred 30 days), IBM must keep performing through the termination date, and IBM has no convenience right of its own. Section 13.1 also lets us exit without termination charges if IBM changes terms or prices. The unquantified early-termination charge in Section 3.4(b) is addressed under the liquidated-damages rule rather than double-flagged here.

input.quote: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
input.rationale: New York law is our preferred position and there is no arbitration clause. The Agreement does not designate an exclusive venue (Section 14.4 only waives jury trial); we note we would prefer to add the courts of New York County, but this is not a deviation.
